name: Steampunk Aviator Look
swap_rule: Se cita el id. Se cambian color, material, grosor, transparencia, estampado y acabados. El corte no se reescribe.
jacket: Very cropped fitted bolero jacket in distressed dark brown leather, long sleeves, tall standing collar, leather straps, antique brass buckles and round metal buttons
top: Ivory cropped top with a deep neckline, small ruffled edges and a wide fitted taupe underbust band, leaving the midriff exposed
bottom: Tight low-rise pants with wide vertical stripes in dark brown and black
shoes: Knee-high fitted dark brown distressed leather boots with high stiletto heels, pointed toes, front lacing, buckled straps and antique brass hardware
belt: Layered weathered brown leather hip belts with large antique brass buckles, short hanging chains and metal gear ornaments
gloves: Short brown leather fingerless gloves with buckled wrist cuffs
headwear: Wide olive-brown fabric headband with round dark-lensed aviator goggles resting on the forehead
accessories: Oval green cameo pendant on a dark metal chain, mechanical earrings with small gears and dangling brass chains

hair.style: Very high long ponytail with strong volume, teased crown, tousled texture, loose elongated strands and a few thin braids

makeup.eyeshadow: Intense black and charcoal smoky eyes
makeup.eyeliner: Strong black eyeliner extended outward toward the temples
makeup.lips: Rosy nude with a satin finish

material: Distressed leather, woven fabric, antique brass and dark metal
estampado: Vertical stripes on the pants, solid colors on the remaining garments
color: Dark brown, black, ivory, taupe and antique brass
